name: MonarchInfoTooltip
title: InfoTooltip
wrapsNative: Button that opens popover(isPresented:arrowEdge:content:) with presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover) and presentationBackground
summary: The small "i" or "?" button next to a label that opens a short explanation in a popover anchored to it.
whenToUse: To explain a label, a metric or a setting in a sentence or two, when the explanation is useful but not needed by everyone.
whenNotToUse: Not for anything people must read to complete a task; show it as helper text under the field. Not for a control's name (use accessibilityLabel and help, see tooltip). For interactive content use a popover (see popover).
api: MonarchInfoTooltip.init(_ message: String, label: String? = nil, icon: MonarchInfoTooltipIcon = .info, arrowEdge: Edge = .top, isPresented: Binding<Bool>? = nil)

options.name: message
options.description: The explanation, already localised. A sentence or two; it wraps at about 288 points.

options.name: label
options.description: The spoken name of the button. Name what it explains, for example "About visibility score". The built-in name is "More information".

options.name: icon
options.description: info: an i in a circle. help: a question mark in a circle.

options.name: arrowEdge
options.description: The edge of the popover that carries the arrow. The web's side; the system moves the popover when there is no room.

options.name: isPresented
options.description: Whether the explanation is shown, when the app controls it. Without it the button keeps its own state.

states.name: closed
states.description: The glyph in the muted text colour.

states.name: pressed or open
states.description: The glyph takes the default text colour.

states.name: open
states.description: A popover on the raised surface colour with the explanation, anchored to the button, on phones as well as iPads.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The glyph uses the disabled text colour and the button does not open.

appearance: The glyph uses the muted text colour, and the default text colour while pressed or open. The popover is drawn by the system with the theme's raised background and the explanation in the default text colour, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web InfoTooltip is a toggletip built on Popover that keeps focus on the button and copies its text into a live region. On iOS the system popover moves VoiceOver focus into the explanation, which reads it, so no announcement is added. The web's align and iconNode are not offered: the system positions the popover, and the glyph is one of two SF Symbols. contentClassName has no equivalent. Android plans the native tooltip instead of a component.
accessibility: The button is named by label, "More information" by default; the glyph is hidden from VoiceOver.
System behaviour: when the popover opens, VoiceOver focus moves into it and reads the explanation; the escape gesture or a tap outside closes it and focus returns to the button.
The button has a touch target of at least 44 by 44 points.
The glyph and the explanation scale with Dynamic Type; when the explanation is taller than the popover it scrolls.
The open state is shown by the glyph's colour and by the popover itself.
edgeCases: A long message wraps at the ideal width and scrolls at the largest text sizes; keep it to a sentence or two.
Only one popover is shown at a time; opening another info tooltip closes the first.
With isPresented the app owns the state; the button still toggles it.
